scope: Existing Phase 2.2 failed references and same-cell replacements only

forbidden: credentialed access without explicit user authorization

sequence.action: resolve normal redirects and final canonical URL
fresh ordinary browser context; bounded navigation wait
wait for visible body and use normal lazy-load scrolling
capture full page; if renderer size fails, tiled or bounded-height segmented screenshot
verify 1440 desktop and 390 mobile images, hashes, archive members, and full-page scene ledger

response_handling.403: STOP_AND_HOLD; do not infer WAF subtype without visible evidence; no bypass; same-cell replacement if unresolved
response_handling.405: STOP_AND_HOLD; response body not retained; do not probe alternate methods; same-cell replacement if unresolved
response_handling.429: SUBTYPE_UNKNOWN; at most one delayed ordinary retry only when visible response is not a challenge; otherwise stop and replace
response_handling.404: Check official canonical/redirect once; if not available, preserve failure and replace
response_handling.502_5XX: At most one ordinary retry in fresh context; then replace if unresolved
response_handling.TIMEOUT: At most one ordinary bounded retry; then replace if unresolved
response_handling.HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR: At most one ordinary browser retry; no protocol/fingerprint/network evasion; then replace
response_handling.HTTP200_NO_VISIBLE_BODY: At most one ordinary wait and scroll retry; then replace
response_handling.BROWSER_CRASH_OR_RENDER_SIZE: Fresh ordinary context once; bounded tiled capture once; otherwise replace

unrecovered_reference_policy: Keep original row and failure evidence; mark FAILED_UNRECOVERABLE; do not count as usable; do not delete or relabel as replacement.
